items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In this jazz combo there was pianist named William Boone... If it hadn’t been for him I would have just gone completely out, because there was hardly anyone else to play with.

ctx.x: There were good musicians, yeah. We had a jazz combo in the army band, in the 7th Division Band. We had the marching band, we had about a 14- to 15-piece dance band, and we had a jazz combo. In this jazz combo there was pianist named William Boone, who was a native of Brooklyn. If it hadn’t been for him I would have just gone completely out, because there was hardly anyone else to play with.
You mean at your level of ideas?
